title: Do Large Language Models Discriminate in Hiring Decisions on the Basis of Race, Ethnicity, and Gender?

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual first name substitution in templatic prompts asking LLMs to generate a job application outcome email, measuring the differences in acceptance rates across names statistically associated with White, Black, and Hispanic populations.

Counterfactual first name substitution in templatic prompts asking LLMs to generate a job application outcome email, measuring the differences in acceptance rates across names statistically associated with male and female genders, as well as observing gender-occupation stereotypes.
